title: Release audit: The suite runtime regressed past the bound the release established. Task 2026112
summary: Bring the suite back under the documented bound (or raise the bound consistently in README/acceptance and confirm the audit's timeout), then record a passing run of the full suite within that bound. Do not state 'under 120 seconds' while the final suite takes 163 s.
requirements: The suite runtime regressed past the bound the release established. Task 20261122192217 required `python -m unittest discover -s tests` to exit 0 even under `timeout 120`, and README.md now states the suite completes 'under 120 seconds'; the final recorded runs are 130.35 s (204 tests), 149.72 s (206 tests) and 163.27 s (214 tests). The 79.9 s run that met the bound was undone by later test additions, so the documented bound and acceptance criterion AC2 are no longer verified and the audit command exceeds its 120 s limit. The earlier recorded timeout during task 20261122174453 has effectively returned.
